title: Shane Stokes shares a catchy new single "100 DEGREEZ"
htmlContent:
Shane Stokes shares a catchy new single "100 DEGREEZ". Following up his latest released single "40 yard Dash" featuring Danny Towers. His single "100 DEGREEZ" has been slowly gaining popularity since its initial release. The song has made Shane Stokes stand out from others. His fans are going crazy over the song and that is evident from the records that are being broken on streaming platforms.

So, if you’re looking for someone new to listen to we recommend Shane Stokes. His style of music is unique and his talent is exceptional. You can listen to more of Shane by checking out his new single.
